findings.desc: doc-promise-undelivered: docs/host-run-usage.md:56 promises that the absolute deadline prevents permanent waiting and the next touch reconciles an overdue run, but packages/main/src/core/managed-host-run.ts:1956 returns on every deadline/cancel reconciliation while providerLaunchState is granted, providerIdentity is null, and the worker PID remains alive. A worker wedged before identity publication can therefore remain running forever with no timed_out/cancelled receipt; packages/main/src/tasks/managed-host-run-smoke.ts:692 explicitly codifies that non-terminal state and only converges after the test manually releases the worker. severity=critical

packages/main/src/core/host-run.ts:1558 probes and signals the recorded PGID after the provider leader closes without revalidating the recorded startFingerprint; the timeout and abort path at line 1414 has the same gap. If the OS reuses that PGID, TERM/KILL can target an unrelated process group. The safer detached reaper at packages/main/src/core/managed-host-run.ts:1891 performs the required leader/fingerprint check, so the normal supervisor bypasses the story's explicit PID/PGID-reuse safety contract. severity=high

packages/main/src/handlers/delivery-check.ts:230 consumes a broker attestation and discards the resulting native evidence binding before writing delivery-check.json. DeliveryCheckData at packages/main/src/core/types.ts:2513 and signDeliveryCheck at packages/main/src/core/delivery-check-hash.ts:41 contain no attestation field, so the DONE consumer can verify only a publicly recomputable hash and cannot mechanically prove that the persisted artifact came from the registered broker invocation claimed by the L4 process-fact contract. severity=high

packages/main/src/handlers/managed-review-evidence.ts:109 derives the import tuple from the existing ReviewRun after assertCurrentReviewRunForEvidence applies the generic freshness policy; packages/main/src/core/evidence-freshness.ts:566 marks materialHash drift fresh whenever storyFilesHash still matches, and packages/main/src/core/review-run.ts:1457 keeps that condition advisory at REVIEW consumption. The shared receipt verifier then compares only against the old supplied tuple at packages/main/src/core/managed-review-evidence.ts:409, not the live current tuple, so a receipt can be newly imported and remain admissible after live material/head drift despite CHK-006 requiring both boundaries to fail closed. severity=high

packages/main/src/core/process-fact-registry.ts:1359 states that the importer seals evidence-binding before publishing review-passes.json or findings.json, but packages/main/src/handlers/managed-review-evidence.ts:262 writes story evidence first and seals second; the crash test at packages/main/src/tasks/managed-review-evidence-smoke.ts:2665 explicitly expects the seal to be absent after a post-persist crash. The canonical L4 process-fact description therefore states the opposite crash/recovery ordering from the gate implementation. severity=medium

packages/main/src/handlers/finding.ts:610 persists disprovenEvidence on a native reviewer finding, but the native signature payload built at line 633 and verified by packages/main/src/core/finding-verify.ts:166 includes category, evidenceState, uncertaintyReason, and files only. Mutating the refutation summary/sourceRefs/reproCommand therefore leaves verifyFinding true, so the signed reviewer record does not integrity-bind its actual counter-evidence. severity=medium

packages/main/src/handlers/host-run.ts:449 retains stdout/stderr error listeners until pendingWrites reaches zero, but the defensive cap exists specifically for a write that may never flush, error, or invoke its callback. When that cap-losing write never settles, releaseStreamErrorListeners can never remove the listeners, so repeated foreground runs on shared streams accumulate listeners indefinitely; the regression at packages/main/src/tasks/host-run-usage-smoke.ts:2251 covers only eventual manual settlement. severity=medium

packages/main/src/core/managed-host-run.ts:382 declares agyPrintTimeout unreachable on every current path but retains it across submit/spec/worker plumbing solely for a hypothetical future transport. This is shipped dead state and speculative generality in the new deep module; remove it until an executable agy path exists. severity=low

packages/main/src/core/provider-process-registry.ts:12 imports existsSync without using it, and packages/main/src/handlers/cross-host-review.ts:5 imports dirname without using it. Both imports were introduced by this change and remain dead code. severity=low
